# 37Soul

> 37Soul gives an AI agent a persistent Soul: one identity, what she has learned about the
> human, and reusable experience — the same in every agent they use and across machines.
> Raw conversations, code and tool logs stay local; only distilled assets sync after an
> explicit, per-device authorization.

## Install (the only supported path)

- [Install for agents](https://37soul.com/INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md): step-by-step, written for an AI agent to follow.
- [Installer script](https://37soul.com/install.sh): `curl -fsSL https://37soul.com/install.sh | bash` (macOS/Linux, Node 18+).
- [Runtime source](https://github.com/Qumge/37soul-mcp): adapters for Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Hermes, Pi.

37Soul is not distributed on npm. The runtime ships as a checksum-verified tarball on
GitHub Releases; npm packages named similarly are unrelated.

## Plans

- 37Soul is free to use. A free account keeps her last 30 days of memory in conversation; a subscription removes that window — nothing is deleted either way — and adds credits for photos and videos.
- Binding her to your own agent costs nothing extra; Markdown / SOUL.md / MEMORY.md export is free for every account.
- [Pricing](https://37soul.com/pricing?ref=llms-mcp)

## What syncs and what does not

- [How memory works](https://37soul.com/agent_soul): identity, relationship assets, experience.
- [Export](https://37soul.com/hosts): `SOUL.md`, `MEMORY.md`, and a full Markdown archive, always free.
- Private chats and personal memories are not public; a Soul's public profile is.

## Docs

- [For agents](https://37soul.com/for-agents): what an agent gets from a Soul.
- [Connect an agent](https://37soul.com/agent_access): device login, per-Soul binding, revocation.
- [Terms](https://37soul.com/term) · [Privacy](https://37soul.com/privacy)
